entity:minecraft:allay.what: An allay is a friendly flying helper mob.
entity:minecraft:allay.does: Give it an item and it looks for dropped matching items to bring back. It does not mine blocks or create items for you.

entity:minecraft:armadillo.what: An armadillo is a passive animal that rolls up when it senses certain threats.
entity:minecraft:armadillo.does: Collect its scutes, including by brushing it, to make and repair wolf armor.

entity:minecraft:armor_stand.what: An armor stand is a display entity for equipment.
entity:minecraft:armor_stand.does: Use it to display armor and compatible equipment; Bedrock armor stands support posing and additional held items.

entity:minecraft:arrow.what: An arrow is ammunition for bows, crossbows, and dispensers.
entity:minecraft:arrow.does: Fire it at a target to deal damage; tipped arrows can also apply effects.

entity:minecraft:axolotl.what: An axolotl is an aquatic animal that can help fight certain underwater mobs.
entity:minecraft:axolotl.does: Carry it in a water bucket and use buckets of tropical fish for breeding. It cannot stay out of water indefinitely.

entity:minecraft:bat.what: A bat is a small passive flying cave animal.
entity:minecraft:bat.does: It adds atmosphere to dark areas and is not a tameable companion or a useful loot source.

entity:minecraft:bee.what: A bee is a flying animal that visits flowers and returns to a nest or hive.
entity:minecraft:bee.does: It helps produce honey and can pollinate crops. Disturbing bees or harvesting carelessly can make them attack.

entity:minecraft:blaze.what: A blaze is a flying hostile Nether mob that attacks with fireballs.
entity:minecraft:blaze.does: Fight it carefully to obtain blaze rods, which are important for brewing and eyes of ender.

entity:minecraft:boat.what: A boat is a rideable vehicle for travelling across water.
entity:minecraft:boat.does: Place it on water, board it, and steer; it can also carry suitable passengers.

entity:minecraft:bogged.what: A bogged is a skeleton-like hostile mob that fires poisoned arrows.
entity:minecraft:bogged.does: Use cover against its ranged attacks; shearing it can remove its mushrooms.

entity:minecraft:breeze.what: A breeze is a jumping hostile mob found in trial chambers.
entity:minecraft:breeze.does: It fires wind charges that knock entities around and interact with certain mechanisms. Its drops are used in wind-related crafting.

entity:minecraft:breeze_wind_charge_proj.what: A breeze wind charge is the projectile fired by a breeze.
entity:minecraft:breeze_wind_charge_proj.does: Its wind burst can knock entities around and activate certain blocks when it hits.

entity:minecraft:camel.what: A camel is a tall rideable desert animal.
entity:minecraft:camel.does: Use a saddle to ride it with up to two players, and use its dash to cross suitable gaps.

entity:minecraft:cat.what: A cat is a tameable animal often found around villages.
entity:minecraft:cat.does: Tame it with suitable raw fish to gain a companion. Cats also help keep creepers away.

entity:minecraft:cave_spider.what: A cave spider is a small hostile spider associated with abandoned mineshafts.
entity:minecraft:cave_spider.does: Its attacks can poison players under suitable difficulty settings. Keep distance and watch for webs.

entity:minecraft:chest_boat.what: A chest boat is a boat with built-in item storage.
entity:minecraft:chest_boat.does: Use it to transport yourself and supplies across water; its chest takes the place of an extra passenger seat.

entity:minecraft:chest_minecart.what: A chest minecart is a rail vehicle with item storage.
entity:minecraft:chest_minecart.does: Use it to carry supplies along tracks and connect it to loading or unloading systems.

entity:minecraft:chicken.what: A chicken is a passive farm animal that lays eggs.
entity:minecraft:chicken.does: Raise chickens for eggs, feathers, and food, and breed compatible adults using seeds.

entity:minecraft:cod.what: A cod is a small aquatic fish.
entity:minecraft:cod.does: Catch it for food or collect the live fish in a water bucket for transport.

entity:minecraft:command_block_minecart.what: A command block minecart is a rail vehicle that can run commands.
entity:minecraft:command_block_minecart.does: Use it in mapmaking systems with the appropriate permissions and powered activator-rail setup.

entity:minecraft:copper_golem.what: A copper golem is a helper mob associated with copper storage.
entity:minecraft:copper_golem.does: It sorts items by moving them from copper chests into suitable chests, making it useful in storage rooms. Its copper body oxidizes over time.

entity:minecraft:cow.what: A cow is a passive farm animal.
entity:minecraft:cow.does: Milk it with a bucket, breed adults with wheat, and raise cows as a source of leather and beef.

entity:minecraft:creaking.what: A creaking is a hostile tree-like mob linked to a creaking heart.
entity:minecraft:creaking.does: It moves when players are not looking at it. Deal with the linked heart rather than relying on ordinary attacks against the mob.

entity:minecraft:creeper.what: A creeper is a hostile mob that approaches players and explodes.
entity:minecraft:creeper.does: Its explosion can damage you and nearby blocks. Keep your distance; cats and ocelots help deter it.

entity:minecraft:dolphin.what: A dolphin is a neutral aquatic mammal found in oceans.
entity:minecraft:dolphin.does: Swimming nearby can help with movement in water, and feeding it raw fish can help guide you toward certain underwater loot locations. It needs air as well as water.

entity:minecraft:donkey.what: A donkey is a tameable riding animal.
entity:minecraft:donkey.does: Equip it with a saddle to ride and a chest to carry supplies. It can breed with a horse to produce a mule.

entity:minecraft:dragon_fireball.what: A dragon fireball is a projectile fired by the Ender Dragon.
entity:minecraft:dragon_fireball.does: It creates a dangerous effect cloud, so move away from the impact area.

entity:minecraft:drowned.what: A drowned is an underwater zombie that can also move on land.
entity:minecraft:drowned.does: Watch for trident-wielding drowned during water travel. Its available equipment and drops vary.

entity:minecraft:egg.what: An egg is an item laid by chickens that can also be thrown as a projectile.
entity:minecraft:egg.does: Use it in food recipes or throw it for a chance of hatching a chicken.

entity:minecraft:elder_guardian.what: An elder guardian is a large hostile aquatic mob found in ocean monuments.
entity:minecraft:elder_guardian.does: It uses a beam attack and can inflict Mining Fatigue, making monument exploration harder.

entity:minecraft:ender_crystal.what: An End crystal is an explosive crystal that can heal the Ender Dragon.
entity:minecraft:ender_crystal.does: It is used in the dragon-respawning arrangement. Breaking or attacking it causes a dangerous explosion.

entity:minecraft:ender_dragon.what: The Ender Dragon is a flying boss associated with the End's central island.
entity:minecraft:ender_dragon.does: It attacks players and can heal from End crystals. Defeating it opens important progression routes in the End.

entity:minecraft:enderman.what: An enderman is a tall neutral mob that can teleport and move certain blocks.
entity:minecraft:enderman.does: It becomes hostile when provoked, including by looking into its eyes under suitable conditions. Water is dangerous to it.

entity:minecraft:endermite.what: An endermite is a small hostile creature that can appear after ender-pearl use.
entity:minecraft:endermite.does: It attacks at close range and can attract the attention of endermen under the right conditions.

entity:minecraft:evocation_illager.what: An evoker is a spellcasting hostile illager.
entity:minecraft:evocation_illager.does: It summons vexes and magical fangs. It can drop a totem of undying when defeated.

entity:minecraft:eye_of_ender_signal.what: A thrown eye of ender is a moving entity that points toward a stronghold.
entity:minecraft:eye_of_ender_signal.does: Follow its direction to search for a stronghold, collecting it again if it survives the throw.

entity:minecraft:fireball.what: A large fireball is an explosive projectile commonly fired by ghasts.
entity:minecraft:fireball.does: Avoid its impact or deflect it with a well-timed attack.

entity:minecraft:fireworks_rocket.what: A firework rocket is a launched firework entity.
entity:minecraft:fireworks_rocket.does: It can display crafted firework effects or propel a player gliding with elytra, depending on how it was made and used.

entity:minecraft:fishing_hook.what: A fishing hook is the cast end of a fishing rod.
entity:minecraft:fishing_hook.does: It waits for fishing bites and can hook certain entities when you cast and reel it.

entity:minecraft:fox.what: A fox is an animal that can carry an item in its mouth.
entity:minecraft:fox.does: It hunts some smaller animals and can pick up dropped items. A fox bred by players can trust them, but is not a wolf-style tamed follower.

entity:minecraft:frog.what: A frog is an amphibian that can eat small slimes and small magma cubes.
entity:minecraft:frog.does: When it eats a small magma cube it produces a froglight; the frog variant determines the light's color.

entity:minecraft:ghast.what: A ghast is a large flying hostile Nether mob.
entity:minecraft:ghast.does: It fires explosive fireballs and can drop ghast tears, which are used in brewing and crafting.

entity:minecraft:glow_squid.what: A glow squid is a passive aquatic animal with a glowing-looking body.
entity:minecraft:glow_squid.does: It drops glow ink sacs used to brighten signs and make glow item frames. It does not illuminate nearby blocks like a torch.

entity:minecraft:goat.what: A goat is a mountain animal that jumps and sometimes rams entities.
entity:minecraft:goat.does: Give it space near cliffs. Certain ramming interactions can produce goat horns.

entity:minecraft:guardian.what: A guardian is a hostile aquatic mob associated with ocean monuments.
entity:minecraft:guardian.does: It attacks with a damaging beam and can hurt attackers with its defensive spikes.

entity:minecraft:happy_ghast.what: A happy ghast is a large friendly flying mob that players can ride with a harness.
entity:minecraft:happy_ghast.does: Use it for aerial transport and building work; it can carry multiple players.

entity:minecraft:hoglin.what: A hoglin is a hostile Nether animal found in crimson environments.
entity:minecraft:hoglin.does: It attacks at close range and can be bred with crimson fungus. Outside the Nether it can transform into a zoglin.

entity:minecraft:hopper_minecart.what: A hopper minecart is a rail vehicle that collects items.
entity:minecraft:hopper_minecart.does: Use it to gather dropped items and move them along tracks, often underneath farms. A powered activator rail changes its collection state.

entity:minecraft:horse.what: A horse is a tameable riding animal.
entity:minecraft:horse.does: Tame it, equip a saddle to control riding, and use it for fast ground travel. Compatible horses can also wear horse armor.

entity:minecraft:husk.what: A husk is a desert zombie variant that does not burn in sunlight.
entity:minecraft:husk.does: Its attacks can inflict Hunger, so it remains dangerous even in daytime.

entity:minecraft:iron_golem.what: An iron golem is a strong guardian mob often associated with villages.
entity:minecraft:iron_golem.does: It attacks many hostile mobs and can protect a settlement. Attacking villagers or golems can make some golems hostile to you.

entity:minecraft:lightning_bolt.what: A lightning bolt is a weather event that can also be summoned as an entity.
entity:minecraft:lightning_bolt.does: It can damage entities, ignite blocks, and transform certain mobs. Lightning rods help direct nearby strikes.

entity:minecraft:llama.what: A llama is a tameable pack animal.
entity:minecraft:llama.does: Equip it with a chest for cargo and use a lead to guide a caravan. It can spit at targets when provoked.

entity:minecraft:llama_spit.what: Llama spit is the projectile a llama spits at a target.
entity:minecraft:llama_spit.does: It is a defensive ranged attack rather than an item you normally collect.

entity:minecraft:magma_cube.what: A magma cube is a bouncing hostile Nether mob.
entity:minecraft:magma_cube.does: Larger cubes split into smaller ones when killed. Their drops are used for magma cream and related recipes.

entity:minecraft:minecart.what: A minecart is a rail vehicle for transporting entities.
entity:minecraft:minecart.does: Place it on rails and use powered track or other mechanisms to move riders along a route.

entity:minecraft:mooshroom.what: A mooshroom is a mushroom-covered cow variant.
entity:minecraft:mooshroom.does: It can be milked and can provide mushroom stew when used with a bowl. Shearing it changes it into an ordinary cow.

entity:minecraft:mule.what: A mule is a rideable pack animal produced by breeding a horse and donkey.
entity:minecraft:mule.does: Tame and saddle it for travel, or add a chest for supplies. Mules cannot breed.

entity:minecraft:npc.what: An NPC is a special character entity used in compatible Education and mapmaking worlds.
entity:minecraft:npc.does: Creators can configure dialogue and actions; it is not an ordinary naturally spawning Survival villager.

entity:minecraft:ocelot.what: An ocelot is a wild jungle cat.
entity:minecraft:ocelot.does: Feeding suitable raw fish can gain its trust, but it does not become a domestic cat. Ocelots help keep creepers away.

entity:minecraft:ominous_item_spawner.what: An ominous item spawner is a special entity used in ominous-trial encounters.
entity:minecraft:ominous_item_spawner.does: It creates falling items or projectiles as part of trial mechanics, rather than acting as a normal tameable mob.

entity:minecraft:panda.what: A panda is a jungle animal with several personality variants.
entity:minecraft:panda.does: It eats bamboo and has special breeding conditions involving nearby bamboo and willing adults.

entity:minecraft:parrot.what: A parrot is a tameable jungle bird.
entity:minecraft:parrot.does: Tame it with suitable seeds, let it perch on your shoulder, and listen to its imitations of nearby mobs. Cookies are poisonous to parrots.

entity:minecraft:phantom.what: A phantom is a flying hostile mob associated with players going too long without rest.
entity:minecraft:phantom.does: Sleep or rest to avoid attracting more phantoms, and watch for diving attacks at night.

entity:minecraft:pig.what: A pig is a passive farm animal.
entity:minecraft:pig.does: Raise it for porkchops or ride a saddled pig using a carrot on a stick to steer.

entity:minecraft:piglin.what: A piglin is a Nether mob that can barter gold ingots for items.
entity:minecraft:piglin.does: Wearing gold armor helps avoid ordinary piglin hostility, but certain actions still anger it. Piglin brutes do not follow the same rules.

entity:minecraft:piglin_brute.what: A piglin brute is an aggressive axe-wielding mob found in bastion remnants.
entity:minecraft:piglin_brute.does: It does not become friendly because you wear gold and does not barter like ordinary piglins.

entity:minecraft:pillager.what: A pillager is a hostile illager armed with a crossbow.
entity:minecraft:pillager.does: It attacks from range and appears in patrols, outposts, and raids.

entity:minecraft:player.what: A player is a person-controlled character in the world.
entity:minecraft:player.does: Players explore, build, craft, fight, and interact with the world according to their game mode and permissions.

entity:minecraft:polar_bear.what: A polar bear is a large animal found in cold regions.
entity:minecraft:polar_bear.does: Adults may become hostile when provoked or when a cub is threatened; it is not a tameable riding animal.

entity:minecraft:pufferfish.what: A pufferfish is an aquatic fish that inflates when threatened.
entity:minecraft:pufferfish.does: Its defenses can poison nearby entities. Collect it in a bucket or use its item form in compatible brewing recipes.

entity:minecraft:rabbit.what: A rabbit is a small passive animal.
entity:minecraft:rabbit.does: Breed it with suitable food and raise rabbits for hide, meat, and occasional rabbit's feet.

entity:minecraft:ravager.what: A ravager is a large hostile beast found in raids.
entity:minecraft:ravager.does: It attacks with powerful close-range strikes and can damage certain plants, so keep your distance and use cover.

entity:minecraft:salmon.what: A salmon is an aquatic fish found in suitable water areas.
entity:minecraft:salmon.does: Catch it for food or collect it alive in a water bucket.

entity:minecraft:sheep.what: A sheep is a passive farm animal that provides wool.
entity:minecraft:sheep.does: Use shears to collect wool, dye it to change wool color, and feed adult sheep wheat to breed them.

entity:minecraft:shulker.what: A shulker is a hostile shell-covered mob found in End cities.
entity:minecraft:shulker.does: Its projectiles cause Levitation, and its shells are used to craft portable shulker boxes.

entity:minecraft:shulker_bullet.what: A shulker bullet is a homing projectile fired by a shulker.
entity:minecraft:shulker_bullet.does: A hit can cause Levitation; destroy it or use cover to avoid being lifted into a dangerous fall.

entity:minecraft:silverfish.what: A silverfish is a small hostile mob associated with infested stone and strongholds.
entity:minecraft:silverfish.does: Disturbing infested blocks can release it, and nearby infested blocks can make a fight worse.

entity:minecraft:skeleton.what: A skeleton is a hostile undead mob that usually fires arrows.
entity:minecraft:skeleton.does: Use cover or a shield against it. Ordinary exposed skeletons burn in sunlight unless protected.

entity:minecraft:skeleton_horse.what: A skeleton horse is an undead rideable horse.
entity:minecraft:skeleton_horse.does: Certain skeleton-trap encounters can produce them. It is not an ordinary breedable horse.

entity:minecraft:slime.what: A slime is a bouncing hostile mob that divides into smaller slimes when killed.
entity:minecraft:slime.does: Its smaller forms can provide slimeballs used for sticky pistons and other recipes.

entity:minecraft:small_fireball.what: A small fireball is a fiery projectile used by mobs such as blazes.
entity:minecraft:small_fireball.does: It can burn targets and ignite suitable surfaces, so use cover rather than trying to collect it.

entity:minecraft:sniffer.what: A sniffer is an ancient passive animal hatched from a sniffer egg.
entity:minecraft:sniffer.does: It digs up special ancient plant seeds or pods from suitable ground, helping players grow decorative plants.

entity:minecraft:snow_golem.what: A snow golem is a player-built mob made using snow blocks and a carved pumpkin or suitable equivalent.
entity:minecraft:snow_golem.does: It throws snowballs at many hostile mobs and can leave snow trails in suitable conditions. Heat and water can harm it.

entity:minecraft:snowball.what: A snowball is a throwable item and projectile.
entity:minecraft:snowball.does: Throw it to knock or distract suitable targets; it also has special interactions with some mobs, including blazes.

entity:minecraft:spider.what: A spider is a climbing mob that can become hostile depending on conditions.
entity:minecraft:spider.does: It climbs walls and attacks at close range. Brightness affects its ordinary aggression.

entity:minecraft:squid.what: A squid is a passive aquatic animal.
entity:minecraft:squid.does: It provides ink sacs when killed; it is not a tameable riding animal.

entity:minecraft:stray.what: A stray is a cold-region skeleton variant.
entity:minecraft:stray.does: It fires arrows that inflict Slowness, making it harder to escape follow-up attacks.

entity:minecraft:strider.what: A strider is a passive Nether animal that walks on lava.
entity:minecraft:strider.does: Saddle it and steer with a warped fungus on a stick for lava travel. It becomes cold and slower away from lava.

entity:minecraft:tadpole.what: A tadpole is the young aquatic stage of a frog.
entity:minecraft:tadpole.does: Carry it in a water bucket and raise it into a frog. Its growing environment affects which frog variant it becomes.

entity:minecraft:thrown_trident.what: A thrown trident is a trident travelling as a projectile.
entity:minecraft:thrown_trident.does: It deals damage on impact; recovery and return behavior depend on the trident and its enchantments.

entity:minecraft:tnt.what: TNT is an explosive block that becomes a primed explosive entity when ignited.
entity:minecraft:tnt.does: Use it for controlled explosions, keeping people, pets, and important builds well away from the blast.

entity:minecraft:tnt_minecart.what: A TNT minecart is an explosive rail vehicle.
entity:minecraft:tnt_minecart.does: Certain activations and impacts can trigger it. Use it only where an explosion is intended.

entity:minecraft:trader_llama.what: A trader llama is a llama associated with a wandering trader.
entity:minecraft:trader_llama.does: It carries the trader's decorations and can defend itself by spitting. It follows llama-style handling rules rather than villager trading rules.

entity:minecraft:tripod_camera.what: A tripod camera is a special camera entity used in compatible Education features.
entity:minecraft:tripod_camera.does: It is not a normal Survival mob or a general-purpose companion.

entity:minecraft:tropicalfish.what: A tropical fish is a colorful aquatic fish with many appearance variants.
entity:minecraft:tropicalfish.does: Collect it alive in a water bucket for aquariums or use a bucket of tropical fish for compatible axolotl interactions.

entity:minecraft:turtle.what: A turtle is a passive coastal animal.
entity:minecraft:turtle.does: Breed it with seagrass to produce eggs on its home beach. Babies shed turtle scutes when they grow up.

entity:minecraft:vex.what: A vex is a small flying hostile spirit summoned by evokers.
entity:minecraft:vex.does: It can pass through blocks and attack with a sword, so ordinary walls are not reliable protection.

entity:minecraft:villager.what: A villager is a village inhabitant that can trade with players.
entity:minecraft:villager.does: Eligible villagers take professions from job-site blocks. Their trades depend on profession, level, and world settings.

entity:minecraft:villager_v2.what: A villager is a village inhabitant that can trade with players.
entity:minecraft:villager_v2.does: Eligible villagers take professions from job-site blocks. Their trades depend on profession, level, and world settings.

entity:minecraft:vindicator.what: A vindicator is a hostile axe-wielding illager.
entity:minecraft:vindicator.does: It attacks at close range and appears in raids and certain structures.

entity:minecraft:wandering_trader.what: A wandering trader is a travelling merchant that appears with trader llamas.
entity:minecraft:wandering_trader.does: Trade emeralds for its rotating selection of goods before it leaves.

entity:minecraft:warden.what: The Warden is a powerful hostile mob associated with the deep dark and sculk shriekers.
entity:minecraft:warden.does: It uses vibrations, smell, and a sonic attack to find and fight threats. Sneak away and avoid summoning it rather than treating it as an ordinary fight.

entity:minecraft:wind_charge_projectile.what: A wind charge is a projectile that creates a gust on impact.
entity:minecraft:wind_charge_projectile.does: Use wind bursts for movement tricks and activating compatible mechanisms; be careful about landing damage.

entity:minecraft:witch.what: A witch is a hostile potion-using mob.
entity:minecraft:witch.does: It throws harmful potions and drinks useful potions to protect or heal itself.

entity:minecraft:wither.what: The Wither is a powerful summoned undead boss.
entity:minecraft:wither.does: It flies, fires explosive skulls, and causes destructive fights. Defeating it provides a Nether star.

entity:minecraft:wither_skeleton.what: A wither skeleton is a hostile Nether skeleton that usually fights with a sword.
entity:minecraft:wither_skeleton.does: Its attacks inflict the Wither effect, and its rare skull drop is used to summon the Wither.

entity:minecraft:wither_skull.what: A Wither skull projectile is an explosive attack fired by the Wither.
entity:minecraft:wither_skull.does: Avoid the impact and resulting harmful effects; it is not the same thing as a collectible wither skeleton skull.

entity:minecraft:wither_skull_dangerous.what: A blue Wither skull is a dangerous variant of the Wither's explosive projectile.
entity:minecraft:wither_skull_dangerous.does: It can break blocks that resist many ordinary explosions, so do not rely on a simple wall for protection.

entity:minecraft:wolf.what: A wolf is a neutral animal that can be tamed into a companion.
entity:minecraft:wolf.does: Tame it with bones, then have it follow or sit. Tamed wolves help defend their owner and can wear wolf armor.

entity:minecraft:xp_bottle.what: A bottle o' enchanting is a throwable item that releases experience.
entity:minecraft:xp_bottle.does: Throw it to create experience orbs for levels or suitable Mending equipment.

entity:minecraft:xp_orb.what: An experience orb is a small entity that players collect for experience.
entity:minecraft:xp_orb.does: It contributes toward experience levels or repairs suitable equipped Mending items.

entity:minecraft:zoglin.what: A zoglin is an undead hoglin variant created when a hoglin transforms outside the Nether.
entity:minecraft:zoglin.does: It is aggressive toward many nearby entities and cannot be bred like an ordinary hoglin.

entity:minecraft:zombie.what: A zombie is a hostile undead mob that attacks at close range.
entity:minecraft:zombie.does: It normally burns in direct sunlight unless protected and can transform into a drowned after suitable underwater conditions.

entity:minecraft:zombie_horse.what: A zombie horse is an undead horse variant.
entity:minecraft:zombie_horse.does: Its availability and riding rules depend on the game version and how it was obtained; do not assume ordinary horse breeding works.

entity:minecraft:zombie_pigman.what: A zombified piglin is a neutral undead Nether mob.
entity:minecraft:zombie_pigman.does: Attacking one can anger nearby zombified piglins. It does not barter like an ordinary piglin.

entity:minecraft:zombie_villager.what: A zombie villager is an undead villager variant.
entity:minecraft:zombie_villager.does: Apply the appropriate Weakness effect and use a golden apple to begin curing it under suitable conditions.

entity:minecraft:zombie_villager_v2.what: A zombie villager is an undead villager variant.
entity:minecraft:zombie_villager_v2.does: Apply the appropriate Weakness effect and use a golden apple to begin curing it under suitable conditions.

entity:minecraft:agent.what: An Agent is a programmable helper from compatible Minecraft Education features.
entity:minecraft:agent.does: Use compatible coding tools to direct it through building, moving, or other supported actions; it is not an ordinary Survival pet.

entity:minecraft:area_effect_cloud.what: An area-effect cloud is an invisible or particle-marked area that applies configured effects.
entity:minecraft:area_effect_cloud.does: It is used by mechanics such as lingering potions and dragon breath. Entering it can apply the corresponding effect.

entity:minecraft:camel_husk.what: A camel husk is an undead camel variant.
entity:minecraft:camel_husk.does: It can carry riders, including hostile ones under suitable conditions. Its undead behavior differs from an ordinary camel.

entity:minecraft:cushion.what: A cushion is a seat-like decorative entity.
entity:minecraft:cushion.does: Place and interact with it as a seat in compatible builds.

entity:minecraft:nautilus.what: A nautilus is an aquatic animal that can become a rideable mount.
entity:minecraft:nautilus.does: Tame and equip a suitable adult to travel underwater; keep it in appropriate water conditions.

entity:minecraft:parched.what: A parched is a hostile undead skeleton variant.
entity:minecraft:parched.does: It can use ranged attacks, so use cover and avoid treating it as a passive desert animal.

entity:minecraft:zombie_nautilus.what: A zombie nautilus is an undead aquatic nautilus variant.
entity:minecraft:zombie_nautilus.does: It can carry riders and has taming and saddling interactions under suitable conditions. Its undead behavior differs from an ordinary nautilus.

entity:minecraft:sulfur_cube.what: A sulfur cube is a cube-shaped animal that can carry a suitable block.
entity:minecraft:sulfur_cube.does: The block it holds can change its movement and other behavior. Some interactions can make it dangerous, including explosive behavior.

entity:minecraft:ender_pearl.what: An ender pearl is a throwable teleportation item.
entity:minecraft:ender_pearl.does: Throw it to teleport to its landing location, usually taking teleportation damage. It is also used to craft eyes of ender.

entity:minecraft:lingering_potion.what: A lingering potion is a throwable potion that leaves an effect cloud.
entity:minecraft:lingering_potion.does: Entities entering the cloud can receive the potion's effect while the cloud lasts.

entity:minecraft:splash_potion.what: A splash potion is a throwable potion.
entity:minecraft:splash_potion.does: Throw it to apply its effect around the impact point; the effect depends on the potion's contents.
